# Part 9: Cell-cell communication -- MultiNicheNet 

## 9.0 Installation (once, not run when knitting)

```{r mn-install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages(c("devtools", "BiocManager"))
BiocManager::install(c("SingleCellExperiment", "SummarizedExperiment", "muscat", "scuttle", "scater"))
devtools::install_github("saeyslab/nichenetr")
devtools::install_github("saeyslab/multinichenetr")
```

## 9.1 Settings

```{r mn-settings}
for (pk in c("multinichenetr", "nichenetr", "SingleCellExperiment", "muscat"))
  if (!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Part 9 needs '", pk, "' -- run 9.0 once.", call. = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(nichenetr); library(SingleCellExperiment); library(multinichenetr) })

MN <- list(
  tissue          = "CSF",
  donor_col       = "patient_ID",
  dx_col          = "diagnosis",
  hc_col          = "Hydrocortisone",
  diagnoses       = c("control", "X-ALD"),
  min_cells       = 10,
  min_sample_prop = 0.50,
  fraction_cutoff = 0.05,
  logFC_threshold = 0.50,
  p_val_threshold = 0.05,
  p_val_adj       = FALSE,
  empirical_pval  = FALSE,
  top_n_target    = 250,
  scenario        = "regular",
  n_cores         = max(1L, min(8L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L)),
  top_n_show      = 25,
  package_plots   = FALSE,
  model_dir       = file.path(path$objects, "multinichenet"),
  model_urls      = c(
    lr_network_all       = "https://zenodo.org/record/10229222/files/lr_network_human_allInfo_30112033.rds",
    ligand_target_matrix = "https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final.rds"),
  resume          = TRUE,
  seed            = 1)
dir.create(MN$model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MN_RUNS <- list(
  dx = list(group_col = "mn_group_dx", keep = c("control", "XALD"),
            contrasts_oi = c("'XALD-control','control-XALD'"),
            contrast_tbl = tibble::tibble(contrast = c("XALD-control", "control-XALD"), group = c("XALD", "control")),
            batches = NA, title = "X-ALD vs control"),
  sev = list(group_col = "mn_group_sev", keep = c("sev12", "sev3"),
             contrasts_oi = c("'sev3-sev12','sev12-sev3'"),
             contrast_tbl = tibble::tibble(contrast = c("sev3-sev12", "sev12-sev3"), group = c("sev3", "sev12")),
             batches = NA,
             title = "Stage 3 vs stages 1-2 (within X-ALD; stage 3 = hydrocortisone)"))
MN_GROUP_LAB  <- c(control = "control", XALD = "X-ALD", sev12 = "stage 1-2", sev3 = "stage 3")
set.seed(MN$seed)
```

## 9.2 Prior model

```{r mn-model}
mn_get <- function(nm) {
  f <- file.path(MN$model_dir, basename(MN$model_urls[[nm]]))
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("downloading ", nm, " -> ", f)
    old <- options(timeout = max(600, getOption("timeout"))); on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
    ok <- tryCatch({ utils::download.file(MN$model_urls[[nm]], f, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE); TRUE },
                   error = function(e) { unlink(f); FALSE })
    if (!ok) stop("download failed: ", MN$model_urls[[nm]], " -- place the file in ", MN$model_dir, call. = FALSE)
  }
  readRDS(f)
}
lr_network_all <- mn_get("lr_network_all") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ligand = nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(ligand, organism = "human"),
                receptor = nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(receptor, organism = "human")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ligand = make.names(ligand), receptor = make.names(receptor))
lr_network <- dplyr::distinct(lr_network_all, ligand, receptor)
ligand_target_matrix <- mn_get("ligand_target_matrix")
colnames(ligand_target_matrix) <- make.names(nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(colnames(ligand_target_matrix), organism = "human"))
rownames(ligand_target_matrix) <- make.names(nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(rownames(ligand_target_matrix), organism = "human"))
lr_network <- dplyr::filter(lr_network, ligand %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix))
ligand_target_matrix <- ligand_target_matrix[, unique(lr_network$ligand)]
message(nrow(lr_network), " ligand-receptor pairs, ", ncol(ligand_target_matrix), " ligands")
```

## 9.3 Data: one CSF SingleCellExperiment

```{r mn-data}
mn_read <- function(f, pick) {
  x <- qs::qread(file.path(path$objects, f)); x[pick(names(x))]
}
mn_objs <- c(
  list(t       = mn_read("07R_t_cells_filtered_xALD.qs", function(n) n == MN$tissue)[[1]],
       myeloid = mn_read("05R_myeloidCells_xALD.qs", function(n) n == MN$tissue)[[1]]),
  mn_read("08R_bnk_cells_annotated_xALD.qs", function(n) grepl(paste0("_", MN$tissue, "$"), n)))
mn_label_col <- function(src) if (src == "myeloid") "celltype_mc" else "celltype"

genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mn_objs, rownames))
parts <- lapply(names(mn_objs), function(src) {
  so <- mn_objs[[src]]
  if (inherits(so[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) so[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(so[["RNA"]])
  md <- so@meta.data
  raw <- if ("labels_curated" %in% names(md) && !all(md$labels_curated)) md$orig_label else md[[mn_label_col(src)]]
  lab <- umap_clean_labels(raw)
  keep <- !is.na(lab) & as.character(md[[MN$dx_col]]) %in% MN$diagnoses
  list(counts = SeuratObject::LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[genes, keep, drop = FALSE],
       logcounts = SeuratObject::LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[genes, keep, drop = FALSE],
       cd = data.frame(cell = colnames(so)[keep], source = src, label = lab[keep],
                       donor = as.character(md[[MN$donor_col]][keep]),
                       dx = as.character(md[[MN$dx_col]][keep]),
                       severity = CLIN_SEVERITY$severity[match(as.character(md[[MN$donor_col]][keep]),
                                                               CLIN_SEVERITY$patient_ID)],
                       hc = if (MN$hc_col %in% names(md)) as.character(md[[MN$hc_col]][keep]) else NA_character_,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
})
rm(mn_objs); invisible(gc())
cd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "cd"))
dup <- duplicated(cd$cell)
if (any(dup)) message(sum(dup), " cells in more than one object -- first label kept")
mn_sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = do.call(cbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "counts"))[, !dup],
                logcounts = do.call(cbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "logcounts"))[, !dup]),
  colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(cd[!dup, ]))
rm(parts); invisible(gc())

mn_lab_map <- stats::setNames(unique(mn_sce$label), make.names(unique(mn_sce$label)))
mn_sce$celltype_id <- make.names(mn_sce$label)
mn_sce$sample_id   <- make.names(mn_sce$donor)
yes <- function(x) tolower(x) %in% c("yes", "y", "true", "1")
mn_sce$mn_group_dx <- ifelse(mn_sce$dx == "X-ALD", "XALD", "control")
mn_sce$mn_group_sev <- dplyr::case_when(mn_sce$dx == "X-ALD" & mn_sce$severity %in% 1:2 ~ "sev12",
                                        mn_sce$dx == "X-ALD" & mn_sce$severity == 3    ~ "sev3")
mn_sce$mn_hc       <- ifelse(yes(mn_sce$hc), "HC", "noHC")
mn_sce <- multinichenetr::makenames_SCE(multinichenetr::alias_to_symbol_SCE(mn_sce, "human"))
print(table(celltype = mn_sce$celltype_id, group = mn_sce$mn_group_dx))
print(table(donor = mn_sce$sample_id, stage = mn_sce$mn_group_sev, useNA = "ifany"))

mn_palette <- local({
  labs <- unique(mn_sce$label)
  pal <- list()
  for (src in c("t", "myeloid")) {
    lv <- c(t = "tcells", myeloid = "myeloid")[[src]]
    f <- file.path(path$figure_panels, paste0(lv, ".qs"))
    fig <- if (file.exists(f)) tryCatch(qs::qread(f)$umap, error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
    l <- unique(mn_sce$label[mn_sce$source == src])
    pal[[src]] <- tryCatch(umap_palette_for(fig, MN$tissue, l), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  pal <- unlist(unname(pal))
  miss <- setdiff(labs, names(pal))
  pal <- c(pal, if (length(miss)) stats::setNames(make_celltype_palette(miss), miss))
  stats::setNames(unname(pal), make.names(names(pal)))
})
```

## 9.4 Run

```{r mn-run}
mn_run <- function(run) {
  sce <- mn_sce[, !is.na(SummarizedExperiment::colData(mn_sce)[[run$group_col]]) &
                  SummarizedExperiment::colData(mn_sce)[[run$group_col]] %in% run$keep]
  sample_id <- "sample_id"; group_id <- run$group_col; celltype_id <- "celltype_id"
  batches <- run$batches; covariates <- NA
  senders_oi <- receivers_oi <- unique(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce)[[celltype_id]])

  abundance_info <- multinichenetr::get_abundance_info(sce = sce, sample_id = sample_id, group_id = group_id,
                                       celltype_id = celltype_id, min_cells = MN$min_cells,
                                       senders_oi = senders_oi, receivers_oi = receivers_oi, batches = batches)
  frq_list <- multinichenetr::get_frac_exprs(sce = sce, sample_id = sample_id, celltype_id = celltype_id, group_id = group_id,
                             batches = batches, min_cells = MN$min_cells,
                             fraction_cutoff = MN$fraction_cutoff, min_sample_prop = MN$min_sample_prop)
  genes_oi <- frq_list$expressed_df %>% dplyr::filter(expressed == TRUE) %>% dplyr::pull(gene) %>% unique()
  sce <- sce[genes_oi, ]
  abundance_expression_info <- multinichenetr::process_abundance_expression_info(
    sce = sce, sample_id = sample_id, group_id = group_id, celltype_id = celltype_id,
    min_cells = MN$min_cells, senders_oi = senders_oi, receivers_oi = receivers_oi,
    lr_network = lr_network, batches = batches, frq_list = frq_list, abundance_info = abundance_info)
  DE_info <- multinichenetr::get_DE_info(sce = sce, sample_id = sample_id, group_id = group_id, celltype_id = celltype_id,
                         batches = batches, covariates = covariates, contrasts_oi = run$contrasts_oi,
                         min_cells = MN$min_cells, expressed_df = frq_list$expressed_df)
  celltype_de <- if (isTRUE(MN$empirical_pval)) {
    e <- multinichenetr::get_empirical_pvals(DE_info$celltype_de$de_output_tidy)
    e$de_output_tidy_emp %>% dplyr::select(-p_val, -p_adj) %>% dplyr::rename(p_val = p_emp, p_adj = p_adj_emp)
  } else DE_info$celltype_de$de_output_tidy
  sender_receiver_de <- multinichenetr::combine_sender_receiver_de(sender_de = celltype_de, receiver_de = celltype_de,
                                                   senders_oi = senders_oi, receivers_oi = receivers_oi,
                                                   lr_network = lr_network)
  rec <- intersect(receivers_oi, unique(celltype_de$cluster_id))
  ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(multinichenetr::get_ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes(
    receiver_de = celltype_de, receivers_oi = rec, ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
    logFC_threshold = MN$logFC_threshold, p_val_threshold = MN$p_val_threshold, p_val_adj = MN$p_val_adj,
    top_n_target = MN$top_n_target, verbose = TRUE, n.cores = min(MN$n_cores, length(rec)))))
  md <- tibble::as_tibble(as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce)))
  grouping_tbl <- if (!is.na(batches)) {
    g <- dplyr::distinct(md[, c(sample_id, group_id, batches)]); colnames(g) <- c("sample", "group", batches); g
  } else { g <- dplyr::distinct(md[, c(sample_id, group_id)]); colnames(g) <- c("sample", "group"); g }
  prioritization_tables <- suppressMessages(multinichenetr::generate_prioritization_tables(
    sender_receiver_info = abundance_expression_info$sender_receiver_info,
    sender_receiver_de = sender_receiver_de,
    ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes = ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes,
    contrast_tbl = run$contrast_tbl,
    sender_receiver_tbl = dplyr::distinct(sender_receiver_de, sender, receiver),
    grouping_tbl = grouping_tbl, scenario = MN$scenario, fraction_cutoff = MN$fraction_cutoff,
    abundance_data_receiver = abundance_expression_info$abundance_data_receiver,
    abundance_data_sender = abundance_expression_info$abundance_data_sender,
    ligand_activity_down = FALSE))
  lr_target_prior_cor <- tryCatch(multinichenetr::lr_target_prior_cor_inference(
    receivers_oi = unique(prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl$receiver),
    abundance_expression_info = abundance_expression_info, celltype_de = celltype_de,
    grouping_tbl = grouping_tbl, prioritization_tables = prioritization_tables,
    ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, logFC_threshold = MN$logFC_threshold,
    p_val_threshold = MN$p_val_threshold, p_val_adj = MN$p_val_adj),
    error = function(e) { message("  lr_target_prior_cor: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  multinichenetr::make_lite_output(list(
    celltype_info = abundance_expression_info$celltype_info, celltype_de = celltype_de,
    sender_receiver_info = abundance_expression_info$sender_receiver_info,
    sender_receiver_de = sender_receiver_de,
    ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes = ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes,
    prioritization_tables = prioritization_tables, grouping_tbl = grouping_tbl,
    lr_target_prior_cor = lr_target_prior_cor))
}

mn_out <- list()
for (rn in names(MN_RUNS)) {
  run <- MN_RUNS[[rn]]
  ck <- file.path(MN$model_dir, paste0("mn_outputR_", rn, if (!is.na(run$batches)) paste0("_", run$batches), ".qs"))
  if (isTRUE(MN$resume) && file.exists(ck)) { message("=== ", rn, ": loaded from checkpoint"); mn_out[[rn]] <- qs::qread(ck); next }
  message("\n=== ", rn, ": ", run$title, "  [", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M"), "]")
  mn_out[[rn]] <- tryCatch(mn_run(run), error = function(e) { message("  failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (!is.null(mn_out[[rn]])) { qs::qsave(mn_out[[rn]], ck); message("  done -> ", ck) }
}
mn_out <- Filter(Negate(is.null), mn_out)
if (!length(mn_out)) stop("No MultiNicheNet run finished -- see the messages above.", call. = FALSE)
```

## 9.5 Tables

```{r mn-tables}
mn_lab <- function(x) { y <- unname(mn_lab_map[x]); ifelse(is.na(y), x, y) }
mn_top <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(mn_out), function(rn)
  multinichenetr::get_top_n_lr_pairs(mn_out[[rn]]$prioritization_tables, top_n = MN$top_n_show, rank_per_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::mutate(run = rn, .before = 1)))
mn_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(mn_out), function(rn)
  mn_out[[rn]]$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::mutate(run = rn, .before = 1)))
mn_top_annot <- mn_top %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mn_full %>% dplyr::select(run, group, id, dplyr::any_of(c(
    "lfc_ligand", "p_val_ligand", "lfc_receptor", "p_val_receptor", "activity", "activity_scaled",
    "fraction_expressing_ligand_receptor", "scaled_avg_exprs_ligand", "scaled_avg_exprs_receptor"))),
    by = c("run", "group", "id")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sender_label = mn_lab(sender), receiver_label = mn_lab(receiver))
kable_save(mn_top_annot, "multinichenet_top_interactions", dir = path$tables_multinichenet, digits = 3,
           caption = paste0("Top ", MN$top_n_show, " prioritised interactions per group (ranking, not a test)"))
readr::write_csv(mn_full, file.path(path$tables_multinichenet, "multinichenet_prioritization_all.csv.gz"))
kable_save(dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(mn_out), function(rn)
  mn_out[[rn]]$ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes$ligand_activities %>%
    dplyr::distinct(contrast, receiver, ligand, activity, activity_scaled, direction_regulation) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(run = rn, .before = 1))),
  "multinichenet_ligand_activities", dir = path$tables_multinichenet, digits = 4,
  caption = "Ligand activities per receiver and contrast")
knitr::kable(mn_top_annot %>% dplyr::group_by(run, group) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 8) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
               dplyr::select(run, group, sender_label, ligand, receptor, receiver_label, prioritization_score),
             digits = 3, caption = "Top interactions per group")
```

## 9.6 Figures

```{r mn-figures, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 8}
mn_overview <- function(rn) {
  d <- mn_top_annot %>% dplyr::filter(run == rn) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lr = paste(ligand, "→", receptor),
                  group = factor(MN_GROUP_LAB[group], levels = MN_GROUP_LAB[MN_RUNS[[rn]]$contrast_tbl$group]))
  d <- d %>% dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lr = paste0(lr, strrep(" ", as.integer(group)))) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(group, prioritization_score) %>% dplyr::mutate(lr = factor(lr, levels = unique(lr)))
  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(receiver_label, lr)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = sender, size = prioritization_score), shape = 21, stroke = 0.2,
                        position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mn_palette, labels = mn_lab, name = "sender") +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.8, 3), name = "prioritisation\nscore") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "receiver", y = NULL,
                  title = paste0("MultiNicheNet: ", MN_RUNS[[rn]]$title, " (CSF)"),
                  caption = "Top interactions up in each group. Score = ranking (activity, DE, expression, donor consistency), not a test. Exploratory.") +
    gs_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                   plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_BASE_PT, face = "bold"),
                   plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_MIN_PT, hjust = 0),
                   legend.position = "bottom") +
    ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5), ncol = 3))
}

mn_donor_figure <- function(rn, g, tb) {
  message("  mn_donor_figure v4: ", rn, " / ", g)
  pt <- mn_out[[rn]]$prioritization_tables
  tb <- tb %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::arrange(prioritization_score) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row = paste0(mn_lab(sender), " \u2192 ", mn_lab(receiver), ":  ", ligand, " \u2013 ", receptor))
  lev <- unique(tb$row)
  cdg <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(mn_sce)[, c("sample_id", MN_RUNS[[rn]]$group_col)])
  grp <- dplyr::distinct(stats::setNames(cdg, c("sample", "group"))) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(group))
  if (!"sample" %in% names(pt$sample_prioritization_tbl))
    stop("sample_prioritization_tbl has no 'sample' column; columns: ",
         toString(names(pt$sample_prioritization_tbl)), call. = FALSE)
  sd <- pt$sample_prioritization_tbl %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% tb$id) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("group")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(donor_group = grp$group[match(sample, grp$sample)]) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(tb, id, row), by = "id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row = factor(row, levels = lev), sample = sub("^BIO\\.", "", sample),
                  absent = as.character(keep_sender_receiver) != "Sender & Receiver present",
                  group = factor(unname(MN_GROUP_LAB[donor_group]),
                                 levels = unname(MN_GROUP_LAB[MN_RUNS[[rn]]$contrast_tbl$group])))
  if (anyNA(sd$group)) message("  donors without a group: ", toString(unique(sd$sample[is.na(sd$group)])))
  lim <- max(abs(sd$scaled_LR_pb_prod), na.rm = TRUE)
  noy <- ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
  bare <- ggplot2::theme(axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                         legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.height = grid::unit(2, "mm"),
                         legend.key.width = grid::unit(5, "mm"))
  ys <- ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE)
  pa <- ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::distinct(tb, row, sender) %>% dplyr::mutate(row = factor(row, levels = lev), x = "sender"),
                        ggplot2::aes(x, row, fill = sender)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mn_palette) + ys +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + gs_theme() + bare
  pb <- ggplot2::ggplot(sd, ggplot2::aes(sample, row, fill = scaled_LR_pb_prod)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(sd, absent), label = "\u00d7", size = FIG_MIN_PT / ggplot2::.pt,
                       colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", limits = c(-lim, lim),
                                  name = "scaled L \u00d7 R\npseudobulk") +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + ys +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "donor", y = NULL) + gs_theme() + noy + bare +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
  act <- pt$group_prioritization_table_source %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(id %in% tb$id, group == g) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(id, activity_scaled, direction_regulation) %>%
    dplyr::filter(direction_regulation == "up") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(tb, id, row), by = "id") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row = factor(row, levels = lev), x = "activity")
  pc <- ggplot2::ggplot(act, ggplot2::aes(x, row, fill = activity_scaled)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "white", high = "#4B2991", name = "ligand activity\n(scaled)") +
    ys + ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + gs_theme() + noy + bare
  pd <- ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::distinct(tb, row, prioritization_score) %>% dplyr::mutate(row = factor(row, levels = lev)),
                        ggplot2::aes(prioritization_score, row)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "grey60", width = 0.7) + ys +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "score", y = NULL) + gs_theme() + noy
  pa <- pa + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_MIN_PT))
  (pa | pb | pc | pd) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.25, length(unique(sd$sample)) * 0.35, 0.3, 1.2),
                                              guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = sprintf("MultiNicheNet %s: top pairs up in %s, per donor", MN_RUNS[[rn]]$title, MN_GROUP_LAB[[g]]),
      caption = "\u00d7 sender or receiver below min_cells in that donor. Score = ranking, not a test. Exploratory.",
      theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_BASE_PT, face = "bold"),
                             plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_MIN_PT, hjust = 0))) &
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

for (rn in names(mn_out)) {
  f <- mn_overview(rn); print(f)
  save_umap_fig(f, paste0("multinichenet_overview_", rn), path$graphs_multinichenet,
                width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM[["double"]], height_mm = min(FIG_MAX_DEPTH_MM, 60 + 3.2 * MN$top_n_show))
  for (g in MN_RUNS[[rn]]$contrast_tbl$group) {
    tb <- mn_top %>% dplyr::filter(run == rn, group == g) %>% dplyr::select(-run)
    if (!nrow(tb)) next
    p <- tryCatch(mn_donor_figure(rn, g, tb),
                  error = function(e) { message("  donor figure ", rn, "/", g, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      print(p)
      save_umap_fig(p, paste0("multinichenet_donors_", rn, "_", g), path$graphs_multinichenet,
                    width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM[["double"]], height_mm = min(FIG_MAX_DEPTH_MM, 45 + 3.4 * nrow(tb)))
    }
    if (isTRUE(MN$package_plots)) {
      pp <- tryCatch(multinichenetr::make_sample_lr_prod_activity_plots_Omnipath(
        mn_out[[rn]]$prioritization_tables, dplyr::inner_join(tb, lr_network_all, by = c("ligand", "receptor"))),
        error = function(e) { message("  package plot ", rn, "/", g, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
      if (!is.null(pp)) ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_multinichenet,
                                                  paste0("multinichenet_donors_pkg_", rn, "_", g, ".pdf")),
                                        pp, width = 22, height = 6 + 0.35 * nrow(tb), units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```
